label: 2011 final model (live dashboard)
description: The final model: the October 2012 timber update with its default files, as found in the QUT repository snapshot of the Carrying Capacity Dashboard (the model saved 2012-10-17). It matches the Ecological Modelling paper and the thesis text and Tables 7 and 14. The live dashboard (dashboard.carryingcapacity.com.au) runs this model: all 120 default cases answer identically, checked 2026-10-27. The author's log of updates records the 2 October 2012 timber update as not yet online when made; when the public site received it is not recorded. Known errors included. Its acceptance test is the output of the original servlet for all 120 default cases (baseline/baseline_2011.json). Never edited.
